original_poem:
यह न थी हमारी किस्मत,  
जो हमें मिलते  
बिछड़ने के बाद।  
हर आह में एक कहानी है,  
हर दर्द में एक पहचान।  

यह न थी हमारी किस्मत,  
जो हमें मिलते  
फिर से,  
एक नई सुबह के साथ।
translated_poem:
This Was Not Our Fate  
This was not our fate,  
That we would meet  
After parting.  
Every sigh holds a story,  
Every pain carries an identity.  

This was not our fate,  
That we would meet  
Again,  
With a new dawn.
